summary: Backend-only test for new Reviews/FAQs CRUD + Admin Change-Password endpoints. Created /app/backend/tests/test_reviews_faqs_password.py with 20 pytest cases covering public reads, admin CRUD (happy + duplicate + 404 + unauth 401), change-password happy/sad paths, audit-log verification, and regression on existing public endpoints. All 20 tests PASSED. Admin password successfully restored to original (omar512@@OoD) - verified via final login check returning 200.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~860 lines and approaching the recommended split threshold (700 lines). Consider splitting admin/public routers and seed logic into separate modules for maintainability.

change-password endpoint does not invalidate existing JWT tokens after password change; old tokens remain valid until their natural 24h expiry. Consider a token_version field on the user record or a server-side token blacklist for stronger security.

POST /api/admin/reviews and /api/admin/faqs accept a client-supplied 'id' which could allow duplicate-collision attempts and predictable IDs. Consider server-generating UUIDs and ignoring client id on create (similar to subscribers).

Order auto-assignment uses 'if not doc.get(order)' which treats explicit order=0 as falsy and overrides it with count_documents() — minor: when an admin intentionally sets order=0 on a new review/faq, it will be replaced. Use 'if doc.get(order) is None' instead.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login; brute force protection is missing (out of scope but worth flagging).
Password complexity check only enforces length >=8; no upper/lower/number/symbol policy. Acceptable for MVP but worth surfacing.
